blocked_objectives.reason: The strictly historical, reference-consistent source probe has only 37 distinct resolved dates. Large detail-row counts do not satisfy the predefined chronological date-diversity gates.
blocked_objectives.minimum_requirement: At least 60 valid distinct historical dates for the 60/20/20 date split, plus source/target-quality confirmation (23 more than the current 37). Do not merge alternate exports without verified source-overlap rules.

blocked_objectives.reason: Only the date-resolved subset is prepared; reference scope, lifecycle, unresolved dates and complete mature months remain unverified.
blocked_objectives.minimum_requirement: Resolve the 82 ambiguous-date references in the small source, approve document/event scope and completeness. For a nonseasonal monthly split supply at least 24 complete regular months (12 train, 6 validation, 6 test); longer history is needed for seasonality.

blocked_objectives.reason: Detail rows are not unique orders; mixed dates, repeated exports, lifecycle and complete historical periods are unresolved.
blocked_objectives.minimum_requirement: Validated order identity, event-date grammar, lifecycle and mature complete chronological periods; no row-as-order counting.

blocked_objectives.objective: Recognized revenue or monthly sales-value forecasting
blocked_objectives.reason: Repeated document totals, alternate invoice representations, currency/tax bases, recognition and adjustment policies are not reconciled. The raw-field regression is not a revenue target.
blocked_objectives.minimum_requirement: Finance-confirmed line/document grain, currency and tax basis, credit/debit signs, recognition dates and a complete reconciled time series.

blocked_objectives.reason: No aligned validated realized costs and attributable expenses; inventory value-like fields do not establish realized invoice costs.
blocked_objectives.minimum_requirement: Recognized revenue, realized costs and attributable expenses aligned by period/entity/currency, with adjustment rules.

blocked_objectives.reason: Raw Manual labels do not establish physical units; product identity, service quantities, returns/cancellations and complete item histories are unvalidated.
blocked_objectives.minimum_requirement: Approved product/service identity and units, complete dated event capture and return/cancellation treatment; no inferred latent demand.

blocked_objectives.reason: Mixed movement/cumulative extracts, largely missing item identity on large-audit movement rows, unclear opening balances and sign/date semantics.
blocked_objectives.minimum_requirement: Stable item/warehouse identities, opening balances, signed dated movements and repeated verified stock snapshots.

blocked_objectives.reason: No eligible historical cohort, matured positive and negative labels or point-in-time features; current master records are not outcome labels.
blocked_objectives.minimum_requirement: Validated customer links, cohort eligibility, observation/decision windows, complete outcomes and matured follow-up.

blocked_objectives.reason: Current line status and promised dates do not establish actual lifecycle transitions or completed delivery outcomes.
blocked_objectives.minimum_requirement: Stable line/document identity, dated status transitions or actual delivery events, maturity/censoring and pre-outcome feature snapshots.

blocked_objectives.reason: Existing source-authenticity evidence identifies explicit synthetic titles; these cannot be actual-NOP training data.
blocked_objectives.minimum_requirement: Genuine historical rates with publication timestamps, currency-pair semantics and verified source provenance.
